residency.note: Semester-based residency: minimum 6 fall/spring semesters at the NYU Shanghai campus, final semester in residence. The 64-credit figure is the major-declaration gate, not a residency floor.

creditCaps.label: Online/internet courses from other NYU divisions not counted toward the degree unless approved by petition
Transfer credits (inherited CAS default; Shanghai bulletin directs transfer inquiries to Admissions, states no numeric cap)
NYU Shanghai does not award AP/IB/foreign-maturity-exam credit (may fulfill a core requirement only)
Independent study (max 12 credits over four years, max 8 in any one major)

exceptions: Chinese language (through Intermediate II) and English for Academic Purposes courses cannot be taken P/F
Courses in other languages and Advanced Chinese can be taken P/F, but a grade of C or higher (not P) is required to satisfy a prerequisite for a higher-level course

overloadRequirements.note: Overload after year 1 requires good academic standing (GPA > 2.0) + Assistant Dean approval; no numeric GPA gate published.

deansListThreshold.note: Dean's Honors List: average of 3.65 or higher for the academic year (September-May) in at least 28 graded credits; no grades of Incomplete or N

advisingContact.name: NYU Shanghai Academic Affairs / Office of Academic Advising
